s: pin on which a body turns
8312.full: 1. the pivot, axle or pin on which a body turns , (Euripides) 2. στρόφιγγες were pivots working in sockets , at top and bottom of a door, which served instead of hinges, (Plutarch) 3. metaphorically, στρ. γλώττης, of a well-hung tongue, (Aristophanes Comicus) (ML)

8313.lxx: in LXX for יַצַע hoph., etc.
8313.full: στρωννύω or στρώννυμι (seeBl., § 23, 1; Veitch, see word), [in LXX for יַצַע hoph., etc. ;] to spread: ἱμάτια ἐν τ. ὁδῷ (εἰς τ. ὁδόν), Mat.21:8, Mrk.11:8; of making a bed, στρῶσον (sc. τ. κλίνην) σεαυτῷ, Act.9:34; of furnishing a room, ἐστρωμένον, spread with carpets or carpeted couches (cf. Eze.23:41), Mrk.14:15, Luk.22:12.† (AS)

8314.full: στρῆνος, -ους, τό (cf. Lat. strenuus), [in LXX: 4Ki.19:28 (שַׁאֲנָן)* ;] insolent luxury, wantonness: Rev.18:3 (a late word, first found in a Comic poet, B.C. 300, see Kennedy, Sources, 41, cf. στρηνιάω).† (AS)

s: the bedclothes, the coverings of a dinner-couch
8315.full: 1. anything spread or laid out for lying or sitting upon, a mattress, bed , Lat. stragulum, vestis stragula, (Theognis Elegiacus):—;in plural the bedclothes, the coverings of a dinner-couch , (Aristophanes Comicus), etc. 2. a horsecloth, horse-trappings , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

8318.full: made of the wood of the tree στύραξ, (Strabo Geographus) (ML)

8319.full: a roof : then, like στέγη, a house, mansion , (Aeschulus Tragicus), etc.:—;of an urn containing ashes, (Sophocles Tragicus) (ML)

s: By covering to ward of, bear up under, endure
8320.full: στέγω (cf. Lat. tego), [in LXX: Sir.8:17 * ;] __1. prop., to cover closely, to protect by covering, esp. to keep water in or out (Soph., Plat., al.). __2. to cover, keep secret, conceal (Sir, l.with, Polyb., al.): 1Co.13:7, R, mg. __3. By covering to ward of, bear up under, endure (for exx., see, Lft., Notes, 40; M, Th., 36): 1Co.9:12 13:7, 1Th.3:1 3:5.† (AS)

8321.full: a mass of olives from which the oil has been pressed, olive-cake , (Aristophanes Comicus) (ML)

s: to be fond of, shew liking for
oblige me, do me the favour
to be content with, acquiesce in, submit to, bear with
8322.full: 1. to love , of the mutual love of parents and children, (Sophocles Tragicus), etc.; of king and people, (Herdotus Historicus); of a country and her colonies, (Thucydides); of brothers and sisters, (Euripides); of friends, (Sophocles Tragicus); of husband and wife, (Herdotus Historicus) 2. generally, to be fond of, shew liking for , (Theognis Elegiacus), etc.:—;also of things, to accept gladly , (Herdotus Historicus), etc. 3. to be content or satisfied, acquiesce , (Sophocles Tragicus); στέρξον oblige me, do me the favour , (Sophocles Tragicus) 4. with accusative to be content with, acquiesce in, submit to, bear with , (Herdotus Historicus); στ. τὴν τυραννίδα bear with it, (Aeschulus Tragicus); στ. κακά (Sophocles Tragicus):—;also with dative, στ. τοῖσι σοῖς (Euripides); τῆι ἐμῆι τύχηι (Plato Philosophus):—;with participle, πῶς ἂν στέρξαιμι κακὸν τόδε λεύσσων (Sophocles Tragicus); στ. ξυμφορᾶι νικώμενοι (Euripides):—;rarely with infinitive, οὐκ ἔστεργέ σοι ὅμοιος εἶναι (Euripides) 5. to entreat one to do, Ἀπόλλω στέργω μολεῖν (Sophocles Tragicus) (ML)

8324.full: στίγμα -τος, τό (στίζω, to prick), [in LXX: Sng.1:11 (נְקֻדָּה) * ;] a tattoed mark or brand: τὰ σ. τοῦ Ἰησοῦ, Gal.6:17 (see Lft., in l; Deiss., BS, 349; LAE, 303; MM, xxiii).† (AS)

8326.g: a scale which flies from hammered iron

8331.full: to grow old together with , τινί (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

8333.full: to mix in with, mingle, blend with , Χάριτας Μούσαις συγκαταμιγνύς (Euripides):—;Pass. to be absorbed in a thing, (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

8336.full: to pierce together, to stab at once , Lat. telis confodere, (Herdotus Historicus):—;Pass., ἔμελλε συγκεντηθήσεσθαι (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

s: as with a thunderbolt, shiver in pieces
8338.full: to strike with or as with a thunderbolt, shiver in pieces , (Euripides) (ML)

s: to mix or blend together, compound
8339.full: συν-κεράννυμι (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Dan LXX 2:43 (עֲרַב ithpa.), 2Ma.15:39 * ;] to mix or blend together, compound: with accusative, 1Co.12:24; ptcp. pf. pass., Heb.4:2, T, WH, mg., R, mg.; id., of persons, with dative instr., to be united with, agree with, ib., WH, txt., R, txt. (see Westc., in l).† (AS)

s: to take up a body for burial
8343.full: συν-κομίζω (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Job.5:26 (עָלָה) * ;] __1. to bring together, collect (Hdt., Xen., al.). __2. to take up a body for burial (Soph., Aj., 1048): Act.8:2 (see Field, Notes, 116).† (AS)

8346.full: 1. to join with another in founding or colonising , (Herdotus Historicus) 2. Pass., perfect participle συνεκτισμένος well-cultivated. (ML)

8347.full: συν-κάθημαι (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Psa.101:6 (יָשַׁב) * ;] to sit together or with: with dative, Act.26:30; before μετά, with genitive, Mrk.14:54.† (AS)

8351.full: the fruit of the συκάμινος, a mulberry , Lat. morum, (Aristotle Philosopher) (ML)

8353.full: 1. a gathering, collecting , (Thucydides): metaphorically, ἐν γενείου ξυλλογῇ τριχώματος in the first harvest of a beard, i. e. in early manhood, (Aeschulus Tragicus) 2. a levying of soldiers, Lat. conscriptio, (Xenophon Historicus) 3. a summary, recapitulation , (Demosthenes Orator) 4. (from Pass.) an assembly, meeting , (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

8357.full: συλάω, -ῶ [in LXX: Ep. Jer.1:18 * ;] with accusative of person(s), to strip, plunder, spoil: 2Co.11:8.† (AS)

8367.full: 1. commingled, promiscuous , (Sophocles Tragicus), etc. 2. with dative commingled with , (Aeschulus Tragicus) (ML)

s: to have a fellow feeling for or with, sympathize with or in
8369.full: συν-παθέω (Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: 4Ma.5:25 AR 4Ma.13:23 * ;] to have a fellow feeling for or with, sympathize with or in: with dative of thing(s), Heb.4:15; dative of person(s), Heb.10:34 (Arist., Plut., al.).† (AS)

s: to come up or be present together
8371.full: συν-παρα-γίνομαι (Rec. συμπ-), [in LXX: Psa.83:8 (לָוָה ni.) * ;] __1. to come up or be present together: before ἐπί, Luk.23:48. __2. to come up to assist (Thuc., al.; 2Ti.4:16, Rec.).† (AS)

8373.full: 1. to place beside one also , (Pindar) 2. Pass., with aorist2 et perfect active, to stand beside, assist , τινι (Sophocles Tragicus) (ML)

8374.full: 1. to join or assist in accomplishing , (Euripides):—;Mid., συμπεραίνεσθαί τινι ἔχθραν to join fully in enmity with another, (Demosthenes Orator) 2. to decide or conclude absolutely , ς. φροντίδα to make up one's mind, (Euripides); κλῇθρα μοχλοῖς ς. to make the doors doubly sure by bars, (Euripides):—;Pass. to be quite finished , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

8375.full: συν-περι-λαμβάνω (Rec. συμπ-), __1. to enclose (Eze.5:3 (צוּר) *). __2. to embrace: with accusative of person(s), Act.20:10.† (AS)

8383.full: συμπόσιον, -ου, τό (συμπίνω), [in LXX: Est.7:7 (מִשְׁתֶּה יַיִן) Est.4:17, 1Ma.16:16, 2Ma.2:27, 3Ma.4:16 3Mac 5:36 3Mac 6:33; σ. οἴνου, Sir 34:31 (31:31) Sir.35:5 (32:5), Sir.49:1 * ;] __1. a drinking party __2. By meton., of the party itself, the guests (Plut); pl., σ. σ. (colloq.; see M, Pr., 97), in parties or companies: Mrk.6:39.† (AS)

8387.full: 1. to be of one mind with, to agree , (Polybius Historicus) 2. to consider well , ἃ δέον ἦν ποιεῖν (Plutarch) 3. to collect oneself , (Plutarch) (ML)

s: to close their ranks, form in close order
8388.full: 1. to press or pack closely together , (Herdotus Historicus) 2. absolute of troops, to close their ranks, form in close order , (Xenophon Historicus) 3. to block up, close , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

8389.full: συν-φύω (Rec. συμ-), [in LXX: Wis.13:13 * ;] to cause to grow together. Pass., to grow together or with (Plat. al.): Luk.8:7.† (AS)

8393.full: συν-αλίζω [in Al.: Psa.141:4 * ;] to assemble with: Act.1:4 (EV, mg., eating with, but on this rendering and on the force of the Pres. ptcp. here, see Field, Notes, 110).† (AS)

8394.lxx: in LXX: Hos.7:8 A ( hithpo.), Eze.20:18 A *
8394.full: συν-ανα-μίγνυμι (accusative to Bl., 8, -μείγνυμι), [in LXX: Hos.7:8 A ( hithpo.), Eze.20:18 A * ;] to mix up together; pass., reflex, and metaphorically, to associate with (Plut., Ath., al.): 1Co.5:9 5:11, 2Th.3:14 (see M, Th., 117).† (AS)

s: to be refreshed in spirit with
8395.full: συν-ανα-παύομαι [in LXX: Isa.11:6 (רָבַץ) * ;] with dative of person(s), to lie down to rest with, sleep with. Metaphorical, to be refreshed in spirit with: Rom.15:32 (L, om.).† (AS)

s: to recline with or together at table
8396.full: συν-ανά-κειμαι [in LXX: 3Ma.5:39 * ;] to recline with or together at table: Mat.14:9, Mrk.6:22, Luk.7:49 14:15; with dative of person(s), Mat.9:10, Mrk.2:15, Luk.14:10.† (AS)

8398.full: συν-απο-θνήσκω [in LXX: Sir.19:10 * ;] to die with or together: Mrk.14:31, 2Co.7:3 (see Meyer, in l), 2Ti.2:11.† (AS)
